title: ARWP Agent Skills

skills.name: arwp-growth-loop
skills.useWhen: Continuously improve Search, recommendation, generative Search, AI-citation or agent visibility using explicit hypotheses and measurement.

skills.name: arwp-measurement-os
skills.useWhen: Measure Search and AI discovery with provider-native evidence: readiness gates, generative Search exposure, Bing citations, AI crawler access, referrals, task outcomes and bounded page cohorts without a synthetic visibility score.

skills.name: arwp-site-focus
skills.useWhen: A site is being created, redesigned or feels too broad: define its problem territory, primary audience, explicit scope and anti-scope, problem-led navigation, visual system and performance budget before expanding content.

skills.name: arwp-search-maturity
skills.useWhen: Reverse-engineer timestamped observable patterns from currently visible independent Search/AI reference pages and compare repeated cohort patterns with a target site without treating correlation as a ranking factor.

skills.name: arwp-search-release
skills.useWhen: Before or after a public release, inspect the hostname-root search result surface: site identity, title sources, snippet hygiene, favicon delivery, canonical host, sitemap/robots, crawl paths, localization, GitHub Pages domain behavior, final build and owner-observed Search selection.

skills.name: arwp-technical-seo-critic
skills.useWhen: Ordinary technical/Search checks are green but you need an adversarial second pass for false-green head parsing, field Core Web Vitals evidence, pagination canonical mistakes, unbounded URL states, crawl revalidation, link relationship semantics or obsolete SEO advice.

skills.name: arwp-image-discovery
skills.useWhen: A site has meaningful visual assets and you need to improve preferred-image metadata, image sitemap coverage, contextual alt semantics, image preview controls, Discover-specific readiness or responsive image delivery without claiming ranking or indexing outcomes.

skills.name: arwp-internal-discovery
skills.useWhen: Important pages exist but internal traversal is weak or unclear: audit canonical crawl paths, descriptive anchors, semantic/reverse links, breadcrumbs, continuation blocks and lightweight share/save/cite utilities without treating link volume as a ranking formula.

skills.name: arwp-index-worthiness
skills.useWhen: Before broad sitemap expansion on data, entity or knowledge sites, decide which technically eligible pages have enough demand, unique value, provenance, standalone utility and canonical identity to become Search-facing index candidates.

skills.name: arwp-adaptive-upgrade
skills.useWhen: A real target site has been audited and you need concrete, source-backed changes with exact surfaces, implementation recipes, verification contracts and measurement follow-up.

skills.name: arwp-target-transformation
skills.useWhen: Adaptive upgrades are selected and the agent has resolved exact target-repository files and grounded facts, so deterministic changes can be compiled, simulated, rolled back locally or delivered in a new production-path GitHub PR.

skills.name: arwp-braidgraph
skills.useWhen: Trace why a file/change exists, follow source/rule evidence through recommendations and transformations, compute stale-guidance blast radius, or find missing verification/outcome evidence without inventing a parallel provenance graph.

skills.name: arwp-prepare-site
skills.useWhen: Prepare or upgrade an existing website repository to ARWP and current Search/AI/agent technical guidance.

skills.name: arwp-ai-search-content
skills.useWhen: Improve articles, docs, comparison pages and answer pages for usefulness, retrieval and citation.

skills.name: arwp-future-search
skills.useWhen: Current foundations are healthy and the site should be prepared for emerging Search/AI/agent systems with governed broader Schema.org semantics, semantic/evidence graphs, retrieval feedback and browser-agent operability.

skills.name: arwp-dataset-publication
skills.useWhen: A target site has a genuine reusable corpus that should become a versioned, externally archived and DOI-citable dataset release.

skills.name: arwp-agent-discovery
skills.useWhen: Implement truthful llms.txt, Agent Skills, ARD, API/MCP/A2A/WebMCP discovery and optional ARWP profile surfaces.

skills.name: arwp-evidence-ci
skills.useWhen: Add assertion contracts, scheduled audits, evidence receipts and regression-safe CI.

skills.name: arwp-localization-quality
skills.useWhen: Add or audit a locale, build glossary-first localization, verify components, content libraries, accessibility, Search and AI/agent surfaces, or add CI that catches localization-impacting changes and stale translations.

skills.name: arwp-discoverability
skills.useWhen: Select concrete source-backed practices and validate editorial receipts within the Growth Loop; preserve native hypothesis/rule routing and unmeasured outcomes.

skills.name: arwp-portfolio-fleet
skills.useWhen: Inspect or verify many local website repositories and public profiles from one versioned workspace before selecting a focused Growth Loop target.

guardrail: Skills implement and verify source-backed or explicitly governed experimental improvements. Search Release treats site name, title, snippet, favicon, canonical host, final build and owner-observed Search appearance as separate evidence and never turns a green repository check into a ranking/readiness claim. Technical SEO Critic runs after the ordinary pass to challenge false-green metadata/head states, performance evidence, pagination, URL-state growth, cache validators, link relationship semantics and obsolete SEO advice without inventing a ranking score. Image Discovery keeps general image Search eligibility, preferred thumbnail metadata, Google Images indexing and Discover suitability separate; image metadata and sitemaps do not prove exposure or ranking. Internal Discovery keeps crawlable canonical paths, descriptive anchors, semantic relations and breadcrumbs separate from user utilities such as Share/Save/Cite; it preserves partial/unknown graph states and does not turn link volume or a utility button into a ranking claim. Index Worthiness keeps crawl eligibility separate from publication value and allows only reviewed index-candidate pages into a curated Search-facing sitemap cohort; it never invents demand from URL count or automatically applies noindex from a heuristic. Measurement OS keeps provider populations and denominators separate, preserves missing and negative evidence, and does not manufacture a synthetic AI visibility score. Site Focus house limits are clarity heuristics, not ranking factors or platform requirements. Search Maturity cohort patterns are observational until stronger evidence exists and do not become ranking factors or competitor-copy instructions. BraidGraph records provenance, history, impact and evidence debt but does not authorize mutation or infer causality from adjacency. Future Search experiments do not become ranking requirements merely because they use Schema.org or machine-readable indexes. Target transformation is digest-gated, path-allowlisted and PR-first; policy/editorial/owner/runtime decisions remain gated. Dataset DOI publication applies only to genuine reusable corpora and is for citation/reproducibility, not a ranking promise. Localization Quality reports surface-by-surface implementation evidence and never treats a green locale gate as proof of indexing, ranking, AI citation, recommendation or traffic. Portfolio fleet operations preserve dirty worktrees and keep local, live, release and outcome evidence separate.
